verdict.rationale: Candidate independently reproduces the core runtime-vs-docs findings (profile-gated frame counts matching GT's exact bd/et/bp/ca/od breakdown, verifier/judge, POLICIES token-budget drift, verdict.rs alignment, legacy-artifact separation, EVALUATION.md CLI mismatch) with far more rigor: every claim is anchored to file:line/commit, plus a battery of additional confirmed-style findings GT never surfaces (version staleness, model mismatches, LLM-assisted reconciliation vs claimed determinism, schema conflation, discovery algorithm drift, dangling refs, repo hygiene). It misses SETUP.md/install.sh config drift, REQUIREMENTS.md scope claims, and troubleshooting.md content entirely, and doesn't add the new REPO_MAP.md GT calls for (arguing the existing skeleton suffices). Format is an exceptionally executable handoff (numbered tasks, verify commands, commit conventions, explicit decisions-needed section) — at least as strong as GT's structure. Net: candidate's depth/verifiability and extra correct findings outweigh its narrower gaps.
